layout: Each image: 6 columns × 4 rows. Attack anticipation, attack follow-through, special windup, special recovery, running contact, running passing.

prompts.name: motion-classic
prompts.prompt: Production animation SPRITE ATLAS for AFTERLIGHT. Real transparent alpha background, no backdrop, no shadows outside each cutout, NO text, NO grid lines. Exactly SIX equal-width columns and FOUR equal-height rows (24 sprites). Landscape3:2 canvas. Generous transparent gutters around EACH full-body pose. Every sprite stays entirely within its rectangular cell, soles at same baseline perrow. All characters face RIGHT, preserve reference identity, proportions, clothes, headshape and paper texture. Hand-inked monochrome ivory/charcoal cut paper with rough white-cut rim and tiny mutedbronze details. These are IN-BETWEEN body poses, not attack effects: keep weapons/effects close enough to avoid neighboringcells. COLUMNS LEFT-TO-RIGHT: 1 regular attack anticipation (pullarm back, kneescompressed); 2 regular attack followthrough (armforward, weightsettling); 3 special move windup (gather power, curlbody); 4 special recovery (releasepower, relaxarms, kneesbent); 5 RUN first contact (rightfootforward, leftarmforward); 6 RUN passing (feetpassing underbody, opposite armforward). Consistent body-size and camera across all six frames. Need six clearly DIFFERENT natural poses perrow, not static copies. ROWS TOP TOBOTTOM: Pip round ivoryhelmet paper courier withenvelopeblade/scarf/satchel (special dash); Moth pale fluffy moth traveler with large engraved wings (special winggust); Bolt camera-box head clockworkrobot stripedoveralls magnetic fists (special magnetpull); Wisp hooded plague-beak keeper carryinglantern (special lanternbolt). Reference image EXACTcharacteridentities.
